description: Extended Qwen/SVC Fusion Weight Sweep (Characterization of 0.20 to 0.50 Response Surface)
model_architecture: Qwen3-8B-Base (24 layers, fp16) + 6 merged q8v5 LoRA adapters + Centred Twin Head (wt=0.35)
auxiliary_architecture: 4-View Multi-Granularity LinearSVC with 36k Clean Open Pool

recommended_candidates.label: Conservative Deep Anchor (Recommended for Kaggle safety)
recommended_candidates.rationale: High Qwen agreement (96.9%) prevents surface n-gram domain shift on unseen test prompts.

recommended_candidates.label: Intermediate Balanced Transition (Moderate risk)
recommended_candidates.rationale: Solid local gain while retaining >95% Qwen agreement.

recommended_candidates.label: Local Numerical Maximum in [0.20, 0.50] (High surface-shift risk)
recommended_candidates.rationale: Highest local CV score in the sweep; however, equal weighting risks test-time domain shift as observed in EXP49.
